intro: The UAE is mostly sandy desert, with a long Gulf coast, mangrove islands and the rocky Hajar Mountains in the east.

chapters.title: Sand, sea and mountains
text: The Rub' al Khali, the 'Empty Quarter', reaches into the south at Liwa, with some of the highest dunes in the world. The east coast at Fujairah faces the Gulf of Oman, below the Hajar Mountains.
Dubai and Abu Dhabi have built artificial islands like Palm Jumeirah.

chapters.title: Heat
text: Summer temperatures often pass 45 °C with high humidity. Rain is rare, so most drinking water comes from desalination plants.

keyTerms.meaning: The largest continuous sand desert on Earth.
